_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment (batch S9 UPPAbaby). Represents the original UPPAbaby CRUZ (V1, 2015-2019). Clek lists CRUZ as Liing-compatible via CLEK'S OWN adapter for UPPAbaby. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: UPPAbaby CRUZ (V1, 2015-2019)

clekListed.clekRow: UPPAbaby CRUZ — **Clek** car seat adapters for UPPAbaby (Clek-made adapter)

specs._weightNote: Frame+seat 9.75 kg / 21.5 lb (front suspension removed in the 2015 redesign).
specs._dimsNote: Strollberry: open 102.9 x 56.5 x 94 cm; folded 94 x 56.5 x 35.5 cm (folded with seat attached, self-standing).

brake.type: one-step foot-operated rocker parking brake (flip-flop friendly)

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth with infant car seat / bassinet or infant SnugSeat insert; ~3 mo+ in seat

safety.certifications: JPMA Certified; GREENGUARD Gold Certified (low chemical emissions)

recall.summary: UPPAbaby recalled ~71,000 units (CPSC, Jul 23 2015) covering the 2015 CRUZ (Model 0181), 2015 VISTA (Model 0101) and 2015 RumbleSeat: the foam bumper-bar cover is a choking hazard if a child bites off a piece. Remedy was a free bumper-bar cover and warning label. Applies to the 2015-model-year bumper bar, which is within this V1 (2015-2019) fragment's range; later CRUZ V2/V3 are not affected.

safety.notes: 5-point no-rethread harness; reversible toddler seat; multi-position recline.

specs.foldType: two-hand fold with auto-lock, self-standing (folds with seat attached)
specs.recline: multi-position deep recline (near-flat; from-birth needs insert or car seat/bassinet)
specs.tires: rubber-coated never-flat foam wheels; front ~6.4 in / rear ~8.5 in; front swivel with lock

notes: Original CRUZ, discontinued in 2020 (superseded by CRUZ V2 then V3); available resale only, so priceSources is MSRP reference with inStock:false. Full-size single, ~21.5 lb, two-hand self-standing fold. Clek Liing attaches via CLEK'S OWN 'Clek car seat adapters for UPPAbaby' (adapter-clek-uppababy) — NOT a UPPAbaby-made adapter. Basket 30 lb per UPPAbaby (Strollberry lists ~24 lb for the V1 frame). Heavier/bulkier than the city/shopping target but a comfortable everyday full-size option.
